Question: Explain the functions of the major nutrients in the human body.
reference_answer: Carbohydrates provide energy; proteins build and repair tissues; fats supply energy and essential fatty acids; vitamins and minerals regulate body processes; water and fibre support digestion, transport and hydration. A balanced diet includes all in appropriate amounts.
keywords: nutrients, carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, water, fibre

Question: Discuss the principles of food preservation and two common methods.
reference_answer: Food preservation prevents spoilage by controlling microorganisms, moisture, temperature and oxygen. Drying removes moisture, while refrigeration slows microbial growth; canning uses heat sterilisation and sealing.
keywords: food preservation, spoilage, drying, refrigeration, canning, microorganisms

Question: Describe the physical, cognitive and socio-emotional development of adolescents.
reference_answer: Adolescents experience rapid physical growth and sexual maturation, develop abstract reasoning and identity, and seek autonomy and peer acceptance. Supportive family, school and nutrition help healthy development.
keywords: adolescence, physical development, cognitive development, identity, peers

Question: Explain the factors affecting selection of fabrics for different uses.
reference_answer: Fabric selection depends on fibre properties, durability, comfort, care, cost, climate and purpose. Cotton is absorbent and comfortable for summer, wool insulates in winter, and synthetics are strong and quick-drying.
keywords: textiles, fibres, cotton, wool, synthetics, durability, comfort
